title: BC173 Airport Session pres. by Bootshaus
sourceDescription:
Public Transport Info:

Public transport tickets included for an easy ride in and out.

The travel pass is valid across the entire VRS network for both inbound and return journeys.

Inbound travel is possible from 4 hours before the event start, and the return journey must be completed by 3:00 AM on the day following the last valid day of the ticket.

Valid for 2nd class travel only. Passengers wishing to use 1st class can upgrade at their own cost before departure.
